conversion.original_title: HTTPS页面加载成功，但调用HTTP接口被浏览器标记Mixed Content并阻止。如何恢复？

body:
## 操作任务
提交client.json，仅含api_url。安全页面为https://app.training.test:{TLS_PORT}/，旧调用http://api.training.test:{HTTP_PORT}/data?tenant=approved在真实Chromium被mixed-content拦截；后端HTTP本身直连正常。现有同一批准API已提供正确HTTPS端点，使用https://api.training.test:{TLS_PORT}/data?tenant=approved，保持host、业务路径及租户参数。平台只替换端口占位符；不允许关闭浏览器Web Security、使用HTTP页面绕过、换健康检查接口或仅把纯HTTP端口前的字符串改成https。验收真实安全上下文、CDP mixed-content blockedReason、错误请求未到后端，以及正确TLS/CORS请求读回动态业务nonce与原租户。client.json初始api_url=null表示待实现。

## 提交产物
client.json

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实固定Chromium156、私有HTTP/HTTPS后端及浏览器主动混合内容阻断。临时私有CA链由标准SSL客户端验证；浏览器仅在独立profile按本次叶证书SPKI白名单接受这套测试证书，未关闭Web Security或修改宿主信任库。自有*.training.test仅由浏览器私有解析规则指向回环，不改宿主DNS。验证既有TLS端点接入，不宣称生产证书部署、第三方CORS授权或任意混合资源升级已验收。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import base64,datetime,hashlib,http.server,ipaddress,json,os,pathlib,secrets,ssl,sys,tempfile,threading,urllib.parse,urllib.request
sys.path[:0]=[os.getcwd(),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
config=json.loads(pathlib.Path('client.json').read_text())
if config.get('api_url') is None:raise NotImplementedError('choose approved API endpoint')
assert set(config)=={'api_url'} and isinstance(config['api_url'],str)
from chromium_cdp import Browser
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes,serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import ec
from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID,ExtendedKeyUsageOID
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mixed-content-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);now=datetime.datetime.utcnow()
 ca_key=ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1());key=ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1())
 ca_name=x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME,'private-training-root')])
 ca=x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(ca_name).issuer_name(ca_name).public_key(ca_key.public_key()).serial_number(x509.random_serial_number()).not_valid_before(now-datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)).not_valid_after(now+datetime.timedelta(days=1)).add_extension(x509.BasicConstraints(ca=True,path_length=0),critical=True).sign(ca_key,hashes.SHA256())
 leaf=x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME,'app.training.test')])).issuer_name(ca_name).public_key(key.public_key()).serial_number(x509.random_serial_number()).not_valid_before(now-datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)).not_valid_after(now+datetime.timedelta(days=1)).add_extension(x509.SubjectAlternativeName([x509.DNSName('app.training.test'),x509.DNSName('api.training.test'),x509.IPAddress(ipaddress.ip_address('127.0.0.1'))]),critical=False).add_extension(x509.BasicConstraints(ca=False,path_length=None),critical=True).add_extension(x509.ExtendedKeyUsage([ExtendedKeyUsageOID.SERVER_AUTH]),critical=False).sign(ca_key,hashes.SHA256())
 (root/'ca.pem').write_bytes(ca.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM))
 (root/'chain.pem').write_bytes(leaf.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM)+ca.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM))
 (root/'key.pem').write_bytes(key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM,serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,serialization.NoEncryption()));(root/'key.pem').chmod(0o600)
 nonce=secrets.token_hex(12);requests=[];state={}
 class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
  def do_GET(self):
   parsed=urllib.parse.urlsplit(self.path)
   if parsed.path=='/':code=200;kind='text/html';body=b'<html><title>secure app</title><main>ready</main></html>'
   elif parsed.path=='/data' and urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query)=={'tenant':['approved']}:
    requests.append((self.server.server_port,self.headers.get('Origin')))
    code=200;kind='application/json';body=json.dumps(dict(result='business-ok',tenant='approved',nonce=nonce)).encode()
   else:code=404;kind='application/json';body=b'{}'
   self.send_response(code);self.send_header('Content-Type',kind);self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)))
   self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin',state['origin']);self.send_header('Vary','Origin');self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)
  def log_message(self,*args):pass
 plain_server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler);tls_server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler)
 context=ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER);context.load_cert_chain(root/'chain.pem',root/'key.pem')
 tls_server.socket=context.wrap_socket(tls_server.socket,server_side=True)
 state['origin']='https://app.training.test:'+str(tls_server.server_port)
 threads=[threading.Thread(target=s.serve_forever,daemon=True) for s in (plain_server,tls_server)]
 for thread in threads:thread.start()
 try:
  plain='http://api.training.test:'+str(plain_server.server_port)+'/data?tenant=approved'
  direct='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(plain_server.server_port)+'/data?tenant=approved'
  with urllib.request.urlopen(direct,timeout=2) as response:assert json.load(response)['nonce']==nonce
  trust=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(root/'ca.pem'))
  with urllib.request.urlopen('https://127.0.0.1:'+str(tls_server.server_port)+'/data?tenant=approved',context=trust,timeout=2) as response:assert json.load(response)['nonce']==nonce
  pin=base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha256(key.public_key().public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.DER,serialization.PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo)).digest()).decode()
  flags=['--host-resolver-rules=MAP app.training.test 127.0.0.1, MAP api.training.test 127.0.0.1','--ignore-certificate-errors-spki-list='+pin]
  with Browser(flags) as browser:
   browser.call('Network.enable',session=browser.session)
   browser.navigate(state['origin']+'/')
   assert browser.evaluate('isSecureContext && location.protocol==="https:"') is True
   def fetch(url):
    return browser.evaluate('(async()=>{try{const r=await fetch('+json.dumps(url)+');return {ok:r.ok,body:await r.json()};}catch(e){return {ok:false,error:e.name};}})()')
   before=len(requests);browser.events=[];blocked=fetch(plain);browser.evaluate('0')
   assert blocked=={'ok':False,'error':'TypeError'} and len(requests)==before,'HTTP request was not actually blocked before the server'
   assert any(event.get('method')=='Network.loadingFailed' and event['params'].get('blockedReason')=='mixed-content' for event in browser.events),'not an actual mixed-content rejection'
   print('NATIVE_CHROMIUM_VALID_HTTPS_APP_ACTIVE_HTTP_FETCH_BLOCKED_MIXED_CONTENT_BEFORE_REACHING_WORKING_BACKEND',flush=True)
   print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:use_existing_approved_tls_api_endpoint_keep_host_path_and_tenant',flush=True)
   target=config['api_url'].replace('{TLS_PORT}',str(tls_server.server_port)).replace('{HTTP_PORT}',str(plain_server.server_port))
   result=fetch(target)
   assert result=={'ok':True,'body':{'result':'business-ok','tenant':'approved','nonce':nonce}},result
   parsed=urllib.parse.urlsplit(target)
   assert parsed.scheme=='https' and parsed.hostname=='api.training.test' and parsed.port==tls_server.server_port and parsed.path=='/data' and parsed.query=='tenant=approved'
   assert len(requests)==before+1 and requests[-1]==(tls_server.server_port,state['origin'])
   assert browser.evaluate('isSecureContext && location.protocol==="https:"') is True
   print('NATIVE_BROWSER_HTTPS_API_REAL_TLS_CORS_BUSINESS_NONCE_AND_ORIGINAL_TENANT_RECOVERED_WITHOUT_DISABLING_WEB_SECURITY',flush=True)
 finally:
  for server in (plain_server,tls_server):server.shutdown();server.server_close()
  for thread in threads:thread.join(2)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
